accessibility.description: What Slab does for accessibility, how it's tested, and what hasn't been checked yet.
accessibility.heading: Accessibility

compare/react-aria.description: All of them leave the design to you. React Aria, Radix and Base UI are built for React. Slab works anywhere HTML does.
compare/react-aria.heading: Slab vs React Aria, Radix and Base UI

compare/web-awesome.description: All three are custom elements that work in any framework. The difference is the design: theirs come with one, and Slab leaves it to you.
compare/web-awesome.heading: Slab vs Web Awesome and Shoelace

components.description: All 60 of Slab's headless Web Components, each built on a native element.
components.heading: 60 elements

components/accordion.description: A group of Disclosures where opening one can close the others. Great for FAQs.
components/accordion.heading: Accordion

components/alert.description: An inline message that gets announced when it shows up. Put it on the page empty, then fill it in when there's something to say.
components/alert.heading: Alert

components/alert-dialog.description: A modal dialog that asks before something can't be undone. Focus starts on Cancel, and a click outside doesn't close it.
components/alert-dialog.heading: Alert Dialog

components/breadcrumb.description: The trail of links to the current page, as an ordered list in a navigation landmark. Separators are yours to add.
components/breadcrumb.heading: Breadcrumb

components/calendar.description: A month of days to pick from, or with `range`, a range of them. It's the grid from the APG's date picker, with all the keyboard support you'd expect.
components/calendar.heading: Calendar

components/carousel.description: Slides one after another that swipe and snap with CSS, with Previous, Next and a marker per slide.
components/carousel.heading: Carousel

components/checkbox.description: A checkbox built on the native one, with an indeterminate state and real form validation.
components/checkbox.heading: Checkbox

components/checkbox-group.description: A set of Checkboxes with one label, one value, and one validity between them.
components/checkbox-group.heading: Checkbox Group

components/color-picker.description: A color picker with a saturation and brightness area, hue and alpha sliders, a hex field and swatches.
components/color-picker.heading: Color Picker

components/combobox.description: A text input that filters a list of Options as you type, to pick one or, with `multiple`, several as removable tags.
components/combobox.heading: Combobox

components/command-palette.description: A search for commands, opened as a modal with `showModal()`: type to filter a list of Options, then Enter runs the best match. It's a Combobox in a Dialog.
components/command-palette.heading: Command Palette

components/context-menu.description: Menu's Menu Items, opened where the user right-clicks or long-presses, or from the keyboard, in place of the browser's own menu.
components/context-menu.heading: Context Menu

components/copy-button.description: Copy text to the clipboard with a button, and say so once it has.
components/copy-button.heading: Copy Button

components/date-field.description: A date field built on the native date input. The browser brings its own picker.
components/date-field.heading: Date Field

components/date-picker.description: A Date Field with a button that opens a Calendar in a popover, so the picker is the same in every browser and yours to style.
components/date-picker.heading: Date Picker

components/date-range-field.description: A start and an end date, each on the native date input, linked so the end is never before the start.
components/date-range-field.heading: Date Range Field

components/date-range-picker.description: A Date Range Field with a button that opens a range Calendar in a popover, so both days are picked in one calendar that looks the same in every browser.
components/date-range-picker.heading: Date Range Picker

components/dialog.description: A dialog built on the native `<dialog>`, modal or not. A modal one keeps focus inside, closes on Escape, and makes the rest of the page inert — the platform does the heavy lifting.
components/dialog.heading: Dialog

components/disclosure.description: Show and hide content behind a summary. It's a native `<details>` with a few extras.
components/disclosure.heading: Disclosure

components/drawer.description: A dialog for a side panel. Non-modal by default, so the page behind it stays usable, or modal through `showModal()`.
components/drawer.heading: Drawer

components/editable.description: Text that is edited in place, such as a title or a name: a button showing the value that becomes an input when pressed.
components/editable.heading: Editable

components/feed.description: A list of articles that grows as the user scrolls, like a timeline. Page Down and Page Up move between articles, and a screenreader hears where each one is.
components/feed.heading: Feed

components/field.description: A label wired up to a control of your own. Bring any input, select, or element you like.
components/field.heading: Field

components/file-drop.description: A file input you can also drop files onto. One list of files, either way.
components/file-drop.heading: File Drop

components/form.description: A `<form>` that Slab's controls submit, reset, and validate with — just like native ones.
components/form.heading: Form

components/grid-list.description: A list of rows that can hold their own buttons, links and checkboxes, moved through with the arrow keys and optionally selected.
components/grid-list.heading: Grid List

components/hover-card.description: A preview of what a link leads to, shown beside it on hover and keyboard focus, with room for links and buttons of its own.
components/hover-card.heading: Hover Card

components/listbox.description: A list of Options to pick one or more from, right on the page instead of in a popup.
components/listbox.heading: Listbox

components/menu.description: A button that opens a list of actions. It's the APG's menu button, keyboard and all.
components/menu.heading: Menu

components/menubar.description: A row of Menus, such as File, Edit and View, with the arrow keys to move between them. It's the APG's menubar.
components/menubar.heading: Menubar

components/meter.description: A measurement in a known range, like disk usage. It tells you which region the value's in, so your design can show it.
components/meter.heading: Meter

components/navigation-menu.description: A site's navigation: links, plus buttons that show and hide links of their own. It's the APG's disclosure navigation, not a menu.
components/navigation-menu.heading: Navigation Menu

components/number.description: A number field built on the native one, with stepping and validation included.
components/number.heading: Number

components/pagination.description: Buttons for moving between pages, with an ellipsis for the ones it doesn't show.
components/pagination.heading: Pagination

components/password-field.description: A password input with a button that shows and hides what was typed.
components/password-field.heading: Password Field

components/pin-input.description: A PIN or one-time code field: a row of native inputs, one per character, that submits as one value.
components/pin-input.heading: Pin Input

components/popover.description: Content that pops up beside the element that opened it, in the top layer, and gets dismissed the way a native popover does.
components/popover.heading: Popover

components/progress.description: How far along a task is, or just that it's happening when you don't know yet. That's your spinner, too.
components/progress.heading: Progress

components/radio-group.description: A set of Radios with one label, one value, and exactly one checked.
components/radio-group.heading: Radio Group

components/range-slider.description: A two-thumb slider for picking a range, with a thumb at each end that can meet but not pass the other.
components/range-slider.heading: Range Slider

components/rating.description: A row of native radios from 1 to `max`, with one label and one value, that previews the value under the pointer.
components/rating.heading: Rating

components/search-field.description: A search input with a button that clears it, and Escape that does the same.
components/search-field.heading: Search Field

components/select.description: A button that opens a list of Options to pick one or more from. It submits just like a `<select>`.
components/select.heading: Select

components/slider.description: A single-thumb slider built on the native range input.
components/slider.heading: Slider

components/sortable-list.description: A list the user puts in order, by dragging each item by its handle or with the keyboard, while a screenreader hears where the item is as it moves.
components/sortable-list.heading: Sortable List

components/splitter.description: Two panes with a separator between them that resizes them, dragged or moved with the keyboard.
components/splitter.heading: Splitter

components/steps.description: Where the user is in a task of several steps, such as a checkout or a setup wizard, as a numbered list. Steps can be buttons that go back.
components/steps.heading: Steps

components/switch.description: An on and off toggle built on a native checkbox with the switch role.
components/switch.heading: Switch

components/table.description: Rows and columns, laid out and announced like a native table, that components can render into. Column headers can be buttons that sort.
components/table.heading: Table

components/tabs.description: Tabs and their Panels, with one Panel showing at a time.
components/tabs.heading: Tabs

components/tags-input.description: A text input that turns what you type into removable tags, for values with no list to pick from, submitted one entry per tag.
components/tags-input.heading: Tags Input

components/text-field.description: A single-line text field built on the native input, validation and all.
components/text-field.heading: Text Field

components/textarea.description: A multi-line text field built on the native textarea.
components/textarea.heading: Textarea

components/time-field.description: A time field built on the native time input. The browser shows a 12- or 24-hour clock for the locale.
components/time-field.heading: Time Field

components/toast.description: A polite heads-up that something just happened. It lives on the page up front, so screen readers actually hear it.
components/toast.heading: Toast

components/toggle-button.description: One button that stays pressed until it's pressed again, for a setting that's on or off.
components/toggle-button.heading: Toggle Button

components/toggle-group.description: A row of toggle buttons that Tab reaches once, with one pressed at a time or several.
components/toggle-group.heading: Toggle Group

components/toolbar.description: A group of controls that Tab reaches once, with the arrow keys to move between them.
components/toolbar.heading: Toolbar

components/tooltip.description: A short description that shows up beside an element on hover and focus.
components/tooltip.heading: Tooltip

components/tree.description: A nested list of items that expand and collapse, to pick one or more from.
components/tree.heading: Tree

get-started.description: Install Slab, import the elements you use, and make them yours. Everything you need, in order.
get-started.heading: Get started

index.description: Slab handles keyboard, focus, ARIA, and forms on top of native elements. What it looks like is up to you.
index.heading: The foundation is not the finish.

llms.description: Teach your coding agent Slab with the skill in the package, and point any LLM at these docs as Markdown.
llms.heading: LLMs and agents

releases.description: Every release of Slab, newest first, with what's changed in each.
releases.heading: Releases

releases/0.1.3.description: Nine new components, from Menubar to Color Picker, and ranges of days in Calendar.
releases/0.1.3.heading: Slab 0.1.3

releases/0.2.0.description: Ten new components, from Command Palette to Feed, translations, and an accessibility pass over the rest.

releases/0.3.0.description: Values screenreaders read the way you mean them, headings in Disclosure, dialogs in Popover, and the rest of the accessibility audit.

releases/0.3.1.description: Eight new components, from Table to Date Range Picker, submenus in Menu, and Listboxes of thousands of Options.

releases/1.0.0.description: A stable API: typed events for every framework, custom states in the manifest, and validity, read-only fields and opening from code where they were missing.

releases/1.1.0.description: Validation errors from markup, more of the native form, field and popup APIs, and Ember types.

showcase.description: The same headless Slab elements under completely different designs. Each theme is one stylesheet of ::part() and :state() selectors.
showcase.heading: One set of elements, any look

showcase/cyberpunk.description: A netrunner’s console: neon on black, clipped corners, glow and scanlines.
showcase/cyberpunk.heading: Cyberpunk

showcase/finance.description: A brokerage dashboard: quiet navy, hairline rules and tabular numbers.
showcase/finance.heading: Finance

showcase/rpg.description: A playable, turn-based battle from an original retro RPG: gradient-blue windows, a Menu of commands, HP bars and a boss at the end.
showcase/rpg.heading: Retro RPG

showcase/studio.description: A pottery studio’s booking page: soft clay colors, round corners and room to breathe.
showcase/studio.heading: Studio

upgrade.description: Every change since 0.1 that can break something, and what to change for it.
upgrade.heading: Upgrade to 1.0
